## Semantic opportunities

- **Mismatch reftests as negative controls**: 274 included (kind=mismatch). `rel="mismatch"` asserts the pages render DIFFERENTLY — the runner inverts the verdict, so an Equivalent result is a measured false negative (sensitivity gap). 86 included match tests also carry mismatch links, which are ignored for now (compared against match refs only).
- **Fuzzy reftests**: 566 of the included tests carry `<meta name=fuzzy>` (expected pixel deviation; candidates for principled xfail), 1023 corpus-wide.
- **Alternate references**: 69 included tests have multiple `rel=match` links; WPT semantics is pass-if-ANY-matches, sosie compares only the first.
- **Chained references**: 129 included tests point at a reference that is itself a reftest (A=B=C chain); sosie compares only the first hop.
- **Print reftests**: 408 (in scope or recoverable) target paged media; captured with a screen viewport today.
